from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
cams=['head_camera','front_camera','left_camera','right_camera','observer_camera','world_camera1']
seq=0
def capture(res,label):
 global o,seq
 o=res; seq+=1; res.save('/app/output/%02d_%s'%(seq,label))
 print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in res.meta.items() if k not in ['cameras','proprio']}),flush=True)
 p=np.array(res.meta['proprio']['now']); print('EE',p[14:28].round(5),'TCP',p[56:70].round(5),'GRIP',p[[36,43]],flush=True)
def move(left=None,right=None,label='move'):
 p=np.array(o.meta['proprio']['now']); a=np.r_[p[14:21],p[28],p[21:28],p[29]]
 if left is not None: a[:8]=left
 if right is not None: a[8:]=right
 capture(r.submit('ee_pose',[a],cameras=cams,include_depth=True,video='both',note=label),label)
def tcp(xyz,q,grip=1):
 rot=Rot.from_quat(np.roll(q,-1)).as_matrix()
 return [*(np.array(xyz)-.12*rot[:,0]),*q,grip]
def record(code):
 with open('/app/output/gen.py','a') as f:f.write('\n'+code+'\n')
 exec(code,globals())
